thoughtProcess.description: Brief strategic reasoning behind this decision.

type.description: The category of command being issued.

entityId.description: Required for ACTION. ID of the owned unit or construct executing the order.

actionName.description: Required for ACTION. Must match an action name from the entity's catalog (e.g. 'Move', 'Attack', 'Repair').

targetCell.description: Target hex coordinates for actions like Move, Attack, or Construct.

targetEntityId.description: Optional for ACTION. ID of an enemy or friendly entity being targeted.

targetPlayerId.description: Required for CHAT. ID of the opponent player to communicate with.
